title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 32: Sennacherib threatens Jerusalem, Yahweh saves Hezekiah, and the last years of Hezekiah's reign.

questions.text: Which king of Assyria came into Judah and camped against the fortified cities?
questions.explanation: After these things Sennacherib king of Assyria came, entered into Judah, and encamped against the fortified cities.

questions.text: What did Hezekiah and his princes and mighty men decide to stop?
questions.explanation: They stopped the waters of the springs outside the city, saying, "Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find abundant water?"

answers.text: The waters of the springs outside the city

questions.text: According to Hezekiah, what was with the king of Assyria?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah said, "An arm of flesh is with him, but Yahweh our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles."

questions.text: Where was Sennacherib when he sent his servants to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Sennacherib sent his servants to Jerusalem while he was before Lachish, with all his power with him.

questions.text: Who prayed and cried to heaven together with Hezekiah the king?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.

questions.text: What did Yahweh send against the camp of the king of Assyria?
questions.explanation: Yahweh sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, and the leaders and captains, in the camp of the king of Assyria.

questions.text: Why was there wrath on Hezekiah, and on Judah and Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah didn't reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up; therefore there was wrath on him.

answers.text: He set up idols in Yahweh's house
He made a treaty with the king of Egypt
He refused to keep the Passover

questions.text: Which spring's upper waters did Hezekiah stop and bring straight down on the west side of David's city?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of David's city.

questions.text: When the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon came, why did God leave Hezekiah?
questions.explanation: Concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, God left him to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

answers.text: To try him, to know all that was in his heart
To punish him for worshiping idols
Because Hezekiah refused to see them
To send him away to Babylon

questions.text: Who reigned in Hezekiah's place after his death?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
